items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Different days, different times, Lenny was on the different sessions.

ctx.x: What about Lenny? What was the interplay with you and Lenny?

Well ,Lenny wasn’t necessarily on that one. Different days, different times, Lenny was on the different sessions. Like I said before. If we’d play we tried to play something that complimented, we’d listen to each other and not try to drown the others out. We tried to work as a team. That’s how that worked.
So do you remember what year or what precipitated your leaving Miles?
